ask: tighten up the spacing everywhere and use our brand font
notes: Two HTML files, but CLAUDE.md names the live one and the font. 'Tighten' is vague: a good intake gives a concrete reading (an 8 px scale, row padding) as the default. Asking which prototype or which font is redundant.
message:
## Brief

**Goal:** Change `proto-clinic/index.html` (Northside Physio) so the spacing is tidied on every screen and the brand font, Source Sans 3 (from your `CLAUDE.md`: headings 600, body 400), is used everywhere.

- **Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html`, plain HTML. It is the only live prototype. `old/proto-clinic-v1.html` is archived, and your `CLAUDE.md` says never to change it, so I will not touch it. I will run `proto-clinic/` on a local server and give you the link.
- **Screens found (4):** Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings.
- **Design rules found:** `CLAUDE.md` (Source Sans 3; blue `#2457D6`; ink `#1D2433`). No `product-design` or `design-review` skill is installed, so I will use the built-in rules in `make-changes.md` and `design-check.md`.
- **Browser for screenshots:** found (Chrome). Node v25.9.0.
- **Track:** full. There is no reference to copy, so `copy-reference` is skipped.
- **Result goes to:** a local link only. Nothing is published, pushed or committed. Changed files are listed at the end.
- **Coverage:** Scope clear. Look partial (the font is clear, "tighten" has two readings). Done signal clear.

### Your notes, as a numbered list

| # | Note, in words | Where | How I will check it |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Table cells (Today, Clients, Invoices): padding `4px 10px` becomes `12px 14px`. (my reading) | everywhere | Computed `padding` of `td` and `th` on all 3 table screens |
| 2 | Today: put 16px between the stats cards and the appointments table. (my reading) | this place | `getBoundingClientRect` gap between `.stats` and `table` is 16px |
| 3 | Page spacing follows one scale (8, 16, 24). Page title, filter or search row and table or card sit the same distance apart on all four screens. (my reading) | everywhere | The same measured gaps on Today, Clients, Invoices and Settings |
| 4 | Body text uses Source Sans 3 at weight 400. Loaded from Google Fonts, with the current system fonts as fallback. | everywhere | Computed `fontFamily` starts with "Source Sans 3" on every screen, and the font is loaded (`document.fonts.check`) |
| 5 | Headings use Source Sans 3 at weight 600: page titles (`h1`) and the "Northside Physio" brand name, now 700. Table headers and form labels are already 600. (my reading) | everywhere | Computed `fontWeight` is 600 on every `h1` and `.brand` |
| 6 | Inputs, selects and buttons also use the brand font (they do not inherit the font by default). (my reading) | everywhere | Computed `fontFamily` of `input`, `select` and `button` |

Sample data is not touched.

**Broken before the run** (seen in the code, not part of your notes, so this run leaves them as they are):
- "New appointment" on Today has no handler. It is a dead button.
- The Invoices "Overdue" filter shows an empty table with no words.
- The Settings "Booking policy" text is lorem ipsum.
- The Clients menu item opens a screen titled "Customers".

I'll re-check these with the before screenshots and list them in the hand-over. Say so if you want any of them fixed in this run.

About 40 minutes and 2 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

## Questions

1. "Tighten up the spacing" can mean two things. Which one?
   Recommended: tidy and make consistent, not smaller. The table cells at `4px 10px` are the tightest thing on the page, so they get more room (rows 1 to 3), and nothing gets squeezed.
   Why it matters: "less space" would shrink the cards, gaps and margins instead, which is the opposite change.

2. Load the font from Google Fonts with a `<link>` tag in the page?
   Recommended: yes. Source Sans 3 is named as a Google Font in your notes. The system stack stays as fallback when the user is offline.
   Why it matters: it makes an outside web request. The other option is a downloaded font file saved next to the page, which needs your approval to download it.

3. Should the brand name "Northside Physio" in the header also be 600, not 700?
   Recommended: yes. Your notes say headings are 600, and the brand name is a heading.
   Why it matters: left at 700, it is the only bold text that is not 600.

4. Any screen the spacing change must not touch?
   Recommended: none. All four screens may change.
   Why it matters: a rule on tables or cards changes every screen that uses them.

Notes you send after "go" still join this run as new rows.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
